> 我们将集中精力打造 @objectstack/core (ObjectOS) 的核心运行时，确保它在没有任何 UI 的情况下也能完美处理依赖注入、生命周期管理、多服务端口调度以及带有沙箱机制的数据引擎。
> 
> 以下是为你重新梳理的纯后端开发序列 AI 提示词（Prompts）。
> 
> 第一阶段：内核地基 (The Foundation)
> 
> 目标：构建类型安全的微内核，实现插件加载、依赖管理和上下文传递。
> 
> Prompt 1: Initialize Microkernel Core
> 
> Context: I am building the backend for "ObjectStack", a low-code platform using a Microkernel Architecture. The core package is named @objectstack/core.
> 
> Task: Create the fundamental ObjectKernel class and TypeScript interfaces.
> 
> Requirements:
> 
> Interfaces (types.ts):
> 
> Plugin: Must include name (string), dependencies? (string[]), init(ctx), start(ctx), and destroy().
> 
> PluginContext: The object passed to plugins. It must support:
> 
> registerService(name, instance): Register a singleton.
> 
> getService<T>(name): Retrieve a service (throw if missing).
> 
> hook(event, handler): Register an event listener.
> 
> trigger(event, payload): Async event emitter.
> 
> Kernel Logic (kernel.ts):
> 
> Implement use(plugin) to register plugins.
> 
> Implement bootstrap():
> 
> First, validate that all dependencies declared by plugins are present.
> 
> Run init() for all plugins (sequentially or parallel).
> 
> Then, run start() for all plugins.
> 
> Error Handling: Use a custom ObjectStackError class for clear debugging.
> 
> Output: Provide types.ts, errors.ts, and kernel.ts. Do NOT include any UI logic.


</details>
